source: Step 0 geometry gate of the fine-tune demo (docs/finetune-protocol-2026-11-17.md, gate 2), computed 2026-11-17 on the public Scroll 1 (PHercParis4) segment meshes and HF supervision masks; metrics only.
method: Each segment mesh (tifxyz x/y/z, every 8th grid row, interpolated to about 20-voxel spacing) is a surface point set. For each ordered pair, 60,000 labelled points (inside the supervision mask) of segment 'labelled' are sampled and their nearest-neighbour distance to the whole surface of segment 'surface' is measured, in voxels of the 2.4 um scan (1 voxel = 2.4 um; 50 voxels = 0.12 mm). f20 / f50 = share of those labelled points within 20 / 50 voxels. The nearest-neighbour search is capped at 500 voxels (1.2 mm): median_distance_vox null means the median is above the cap. labelled_radius_vox_p5_p50_p95: radius of each segment's labelled points from the scroll axis, estimated per 1000-voxel z band (percentiles 5 / 50 / 95). This is a sampled check: it finds no labelled point of one segment near another's surface; it is not a proof over every point of the papyrus.
